366:t_012:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Take us out, $$バルビエル$$.」

366:t_013:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is with $$バルビエル$$...」

366:t_013:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Pull yourself together, $n! $$ギルター$$ is coming!」

366:t_014:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「How pathetic, $$いがみ合う双子$$! I'll be the one to see you off to the next world!」

366:t_014:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's no use! From here, we can't...!」

366:t_015:3.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I'll match the timing on my end!」

366:t_016:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Like I care about your circumstances. Now get lost already, poison mushroom.」

366:t_018:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $n. I was looking for $$オルソン$$'s $$オーガス$$ II, so I got here late.」

366:t_018:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If I'd gotten here sooner, then Miss $$スズネ$$...」

366:t_018:2.en:
$n
「...It's not your fault, $$桂$$... If only I'd noticed something was wrong with Miss $$スズネ$$...」

366:t_018:4.en:
$$桂$$
「...Let's go. First we take care of the enemies that are left.」

366:t_019:0.en:
$$オルソン$$
「$$桂$$... I'll focus on supporting you. I'm counting on you to be the attacker.」

366:t_019:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「Where has $$バルビエル$$ gone?」

366:t_019:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It's no good... We've already lost track of him.」

366:t_019:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, wipe out the enemy.」

366:t_019:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go. Right now we focus on what's in front of us.」

366:t_020:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$オルソン$$. I hate to say it, but this isn't the kind of situation where we can celebrate you being safe.」

366:t_020:6.en:
$n
(What on earth happened to Miss $$スズネ$$...)

366:t_021:1.en:
$$カリス$$
「It's been a while, $$ガロード$$.」

366:t_021:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$カリス$$! Why are you here!?」

366:t_021:3.en:
$$カリス$$
「I'm fighting as a member of the Resistance in this area, too.」

366:t_021:4.en:
$$カリス$$
「Right now we're attacking that base in step with your movements.」

366:t_021:5.en:
$$カリス$$
「Good timing. Let us back you up.」

366:t_022:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you sure about this...?」

366:t_022:1.en:
$$カリス$$
「You'll make better use of these parts than we would. I'll be counting on you, $$ガロード$$.」

366:t_022:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks, $$カリス$$! But getting to meet you like this is the best resupply I could ask for!」

366:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(This is my chance...! If I take out $c here, I can win back my standing...!)

366:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Above all, if I pile up any more failures, $$バルビエル$$ will...!)

366:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You squabbling twins! A moth flying into the flames, that's what you are!」

366:t_101:1.en:
$n
「Save the big talk and get over here already!」

366:t_101:2.en:
$n
(I'm worried about Miss $$スズネ$$... Let's end this quickly!)

366:t_102:0.en:
$$桂$$
「First combo play in a long time! Keep up with me, $$オルソン$$!」

366:t_102:1.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I know all your habits. A little bit of a gap won't be a problem.」

366:t_102:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Then let's go all out! Today my head's about to boil over with anger!」

366:t_103:0.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$... If only I'd looked out for her more...)
